issue_body: tbx.RomanTo(s) is supposed to take an uppercase Roman numeral in the valid range 1..3999 and return its integer value, where a symbol that is smaller than the one immediately to its right counts as a subtraction (so "IV" is 4, "IX" is 9, "XL" is 40, "MMXXIV" is 2024). The subtractive cases come out too big: "IV" gives 6 and "IX" gives 11, as if every symbol were just added together. Please make it compute the right value.
